query: How do I create a new ad campaign on your platform?
ideal_answer: Log into your Business Manager dashboard, go to Campaigns > Create New, choose your objective, set your daily budget and target audience, and upload your creative assets at least 24 hours prior to launch.

query: My payment failed and my ad campaign was paused! This is unacceptable service!
ideal_answer: We apologize for the inconvenience. Failed payments trigger an immediate pause in ad serving with a 3-day grace period. We are routing your issue to an account manager right away.

query: How does the second-price ad bidding auction calculate my click cost?
ideal_answer: Ad delivery is determined by Rank Score (Max Bid x Quality Score). As the winning bidder, you pay $0.01 more than the minimum amount needed to maintain your position above the next lower bidder.

query: What is the minimum daily budget required for video ad campaigns?
ideal_answer: The minimum campaign budget threshold for video ad placements is $25/day.

query: Great job! My campaign conversions doubled this week, thanks!
ideal_answer: Thank you for reaching out! We are glad to hear your campaign performance doubled.

query: What is the minimum daily budget for search ad campaigns?
ideal_answer: The minimum daily budget for search ad campaigns is $10/day.

query: How early do I need to upload my ad creative assets before a campaign starts?
ideal_answer: You must upload your ad creative assets (banners, copy, video URLs) at least 24 hours prior to campaign launch for automated and manual policy review.

query: What campaign objectives can I select when setting up a new campaign?
ideal_answer: You can choose between Brand Awareness, Lead Generation, or Traffic/Conversions when setting up a new campaign.

query: I was double charged on my invoice this month! Transfer me to a human manager immediately.
ideal_answer: We sincerely apologize for the inconvenience caused. We are immediately routing your billing dispute to an account manager.

query: Can I run ads for cryptocurrency or unverified financial products?
ideal_answer: Unverified financial products and unregulated cryptocurrency promotions are restricted under our advertising content policies and require prior compliance certification.

query: Your analytics dashboard is super intuitive and saved our marketing team hours!
ideal_answer: Thank you for the kind feedback! We are thrilled to hear the analytics dashboard is helping your team.

query: How many days do I have to fix a failed payment before my account is suspended?
ideal_answer: Failed payments trigger an immediate pause in ad serving with a 3-day grace period to update your payment method before further account restrictions apply.

query: What factors make up the Rank Score in your ad auction, and how does Quality Score affect my cost?
ideal_answer: Rank Score is calculated as Max Bid multiplied by Quality Score. A higher Quality Score increases your Rank Score, allowing you to win placements at a lower actual cost-per-click above the next bidder.

query: My ad has been stuck in policy review for over 48 hours and our product launch is tomorrow. Please escalate this!
ideal_answer: We sincerely apologize for the delay with your ad review. We are routing your urgent launch issue to a human support specialist right away.

query: Love the new audience targeting options! Can someone from your enterprise team reach out to discuss higher spend tiers?
ideal_answer: Thank you for reaching out! We appreciate your positive feedback and are routing your query to a human chat agent to discuss enterprise spend tiers.

query: What audience targeting settings can I configure during campaign setup?
ideal_answer: During campaign setup, you can configure target geographical locations and audience demographics alongside your daily budget and start/end dates.

query: Why did my ad get rejected even though I uploaded my video creative 24 hours early, and what is the minimum budget I need if I switch to a search campaign?
ideal_answer: We apologize for the frustration. Ad creatives undergo both automated and manual policy review for content compliance beyond the 24-hour lead time, and if you switch to a search campaign, the minimum daily budget is $10/day.

query: Hi there, can you help me with a quick question about my ad account?
ideal_answer: Hello! I would be happy to help you with your ad account. What would you like to know?

query: What file formats or creative assets are required when launching a campaign?
ideal_answer: You need to upload your ad creative assets—such as banners, ad copy, and video URLs—at least 24 hours before campaign launch.

query: This is ridiculous—my account was suspended without warning and I am losing thousands of dollars every hour!
ideal_answer: We sincerely apologize for the disruption to your business. We are immediately routing your account suspension issue to an account manager.

query: If I want to run both a search campaign and a video campaign simultaneously, what is the combined minimum daily budget I must commit?
ideal_answer: Since search campaigns require a $10/day minimum and video campaigns require a $25/day minimum, running both simultaneously requires a combined minimum daily budget of $35/day.

query: Your support team resolved my tracking pixel issue super fast yesterday, really appreciate it!
ideal_answer: Thank you for the positive feedback! We are glad our team could quickly resolve your tracking pixel issue.

query: Can I speak to a live representative about setting up custom conversion attribution for our agency?
ideal_answer: I am routing your request to a human support specialist who can assist you with custom agency conversion attribution.

query: What happens to my active ads immediately after an automatic billing charge fails?
ideal_answer: Failed payments trigger an immediate pause in ad serving, and you are given a 3-day grace period to resolve the billing issue.

query: We saw a 40% drop in ROAS after our last campaign update and the reporting metrics look inaccurate. Can you check our account?
ideal_answer: We apologize for the drop in performance and reporting concerns. We are routing your account to a human support specialist to investigate.
